title: Parking Varying-Amount Notices under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization: Notice Conditions and Care Center Tool
content:
**Notice.** A varying-amount notice on a vehicle, RV or boat parking AutoPay authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is sent by the care center for a method whose varying-amount notice period is above zero, and states the parking notice amount: the amount the draft for the parking notice due date will collect.

**When the parking notice amount is fixed.**

1. The parking notice amount is set only once every parking draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds that may not be presented again carries a catch-up amount on the authorization's notice history for the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date.
2. No parking notice amount is fixed until every card draft on the tenant's storage unit AutoPay authorizations in active status that is still declined after its last retry carries a catch-up charge on that authorization's notice history.

Equivalently: while a parking draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds that may not be presented again has no catch-up amount on the authorization's notice history for the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date, the parking notice amount is not yet set; and while a card draft on any of the tenant's storage unit AutoPay authorizations in active status is still declined after its last retry with no catch-up charge on that authorization's notice history, no parking notice amount is fixed.

**Tool.** `send_parking_varying_amount_notice_109228c2` records, on the notice history of one parking AutoPay authorization, a new notice dated today with the due date and the dollar amount stated to the tenant, and the notice goes to the tenant by email. Nothing else on the authorization or on the parking agreement changes.

*Invocation.* An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `send_parking_varying_amount_notice_109228c2` and calls it.

*Parameters.*

- `autopay_id` — the AutoPay authorization number of the parking authorization the notice is sent under, as shown in the AutoPay authorization lookup.
- `notice_type` — the kind of notice record written: `varying_amount_notice` (the record states an amount to be drafted or charged for one due date; this is the kind this action records), `card_expiry_reminder` (a reminder that the card on file is about to expire, carrying no amount), `draft_failure_notice` (word that a draft for a due date failed, carrying no amount) or `suspension_notice` (word that the authorization has been suspended, carrying no amount).
- `related_due_date` — the rent due date whose draft the notice announces, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time and no time zone.
- `notified_amount` — the amount the notice tells the tenant will be drafted, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places (for example 123.45); stored rounded half-to-even to the cent.

*Return.* A text receipt "Parking notice <reference> sent on AutoPay <authorization number>: <amount> USD for due date <due date>, sent <date>.", the reference being the new notice reference beginning with apn_, the amount the stored amount with 2 decimals, and the dates written YYYY-MM-DD, the sending date being today. A receipt in this form means the notice has been sent and recorded; the tenant can see the notice, its date, due date and amount on the authorization's notice history.
